subject.title: chore(queue): add six autonomous PR remediation jobs

question: Should this six-target remediation batch land as merge-capable autonomous jobs, or should the conflicting/unknown target PRs be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The patch is generated and guarded, but it changes the live automation queue in a way that can lead to future merge or fix PR mutations once maintainers open execution gates.

options.title: Merge as staged queue
options.body: Land the files and dispatch them as canaries, relying on live merge preflight to block or repair stale/conflicting targets.

options.title: Narrow risky targets
options.body: Remove or convert the currently conflicting/unknown target PR jobs before merge if maintainers want the batch to contain only clean merge candidates.

options.title: Pause this refill
options.body: Do not land the queue refill until the current autonomous workload has enough reviewed capacity for more write-mode jobs.

recommendation.title: Merge as staged queue
recommendation.body: Land the files and dispatch them as canaries, relying on live merge preflight to block or repair stale/conflicting targets.
